situation: Two startups deciding whether to keep an informal data-sharing pact alive or quietly poach each other's customers

players.name: Northwind
players.note: Founder-led, values reputation but under board pressure to grow fast

players.name: Kestrel
players.note: Burned before, quick to retaliate and slow to forgive

rationale.R: keeping the pact ~= steady shared leads, worth roughly a normal quarter
rationale.T: poaching once while they trust you = a big customer windfall, upper bound if their book is rich
rationale.P: mutual poaching = costly price war, both bleed but survive
rationale.S: being poached while cooperating = losing marquee accounts; range spans mild to severe
rationale.w: unknown how long both stay in market; wide because a funding event could end it abruptly
rationale.noise: misread signals: a sales rep going off-script can look like a betrayal
